entries.title: Romans 15:1
segments: Now we that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

entries.title: Romans 15:2
segments: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, unto edifying.

entries.title: Romans 15:3
segments: For Christ also pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell upon me.

entries.title: Romans 15:4
segments: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that through patience and through comfort of the scriptures we might have hope.

entries.title: Romans 15:5
segments: Now the God of patience and of comfort grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus:

entries.title: Romans 15:6
segments: that with one accord ye may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Romans 15:7
segments: Wherefore receive ye one another, even as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.

entries.title: Romans 15:8
segments: For I say that Christ hath been made a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises [given] unto the fathers,

entries.title: Romans 15:9
segments: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, Therefore will I give praise unto thee among the Gentiles, And sing unto thy name.

entries.title: Romans 15:10
segments: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

entries.title: Romans 15:11
segments: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; And let all the peoples praise him.

entries.title: Romans 15:12
segments: And again, Isaiah saith, There shall be the root of Jesse, And he that ariseth to rule over the Gentiles; On him shall the Gentiles hope.

entries.title: Romans 15:13
segments: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 15:14
segments: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

entries.title: Romans 15:15
segments: But I write the more boldly unto you in some measure, as putting you again in remembrance, because of the grace that was given me of God,

entries.title: Romans 15:16
segments: that I should be a minister of Christ Jesus unto the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 15:17
segments: I have therefore my glorifying in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

entries.title: Romans 15:18
segments: For I will not dare to speak of any things save those which Christ wrought through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

entries.title: Romans 15:19
segments: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and round about even unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ;

entries.title: Romans 15:20
segments: yea, making it my aim so to preach the gospel, not where Christ was [already] named, that I might not build upon another man's foundation;

entries.title: Romans 15:21
segments: but, as it is written, They shall see, to whom no tidings of him came, And they who have not heard shall understand.

entries.title: Romans 15:22
segments: Wherefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you:

entries.title: Romans 15:23
segments: but now, having no more any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come unto you,

entries.title: Romans 15:24
segments: whensoever I go unto Spain (for I hope to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first in some measure I shall have been satisfied with your company)--

entries.title: Romans 15:25
segments: but now, I [say], I go unto Jerusalem, ministering unto the saints.

entries.title: Romans 15:26
segments: For it hath been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints that are at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Romans 15:27
segments: Yea, it hath been their good pleasure; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it [to them] also to minister unto them in carnal things.

entries.title: Romans 15:28
segments: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by you unto Spain.

entries.title: Romans 15:29
segments: And I know that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of Christ.

entries.title: Romans 15:30
segments: Now I beseech you, brethren, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

entries.title: Romans 15:31
segments: that I may be delivered from them that are disobedient in Judaea, and [that] my ministration which [I have] for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

entries.title: Romans 15:32
segments: that I may come unto you in joy through the will of God, and together with you find rest.

entries.title: Romans 15:33
segments: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
